message:
fix(vscode): use forward slashes in typescript.tsdk path

Backslashes don't resolve under WSL2/Linux, so VS Code silently fell
back to its bundled TS server and orphaned .storybook/preview.tsx into
an inferred project — producing a false ts(2307) on @storybook/react-vite
even though the workspace tsc resolves it cleanly.
